gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2791 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 16.1 million in 2020. This favorable development was primarily driven by releases in long-tail casualty classes (GBP 5.4m) and the short-tail account (GBP 4.5m). Specifically, the Irish motor account contributed GBP 3.72m to the release due to better than expected performance. Further releases stemmed from favorable legal rulings related to Superstorm Sandy (a reduction of $4.6m in ultimate gross loss, equivalent to GBP 3.357m release) and a market-wide arbitration for a 2015 Canadian wildfire reinsurance contract (GBP 3.2m release). Partially offsetting these releases was a 10% deterioration in gross Hurricane Irma losses and a GBP 4.01m strengthening for 2017 catastrophes (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Californian Wildfires).

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At the 2020 year end the syndicate opened with gross claims outstanding of GBP 322.2m. Management report that prior years (notably 2017 and earlier) produced a favourable contribution to the calendar year result, with back years contributing GBP 17.6m to the annual result driven by better than expected reserve utilisation. The movement is described as driven by favourable claims development (including improved performance on an Irish motor account); however an explicit aggregate GROSS prior year development figure is not presented in a single, unambiguous 'movement in prior years' line in the accounts, and is therefore not reported here as a quantified gross amount.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding is taken from Note 6 (explicit). An explicit, single aggregated GROSS prior year development amount is not clearly presented in the financial statements (management narrative cites net/back-year contributions). Net prior-year release figures are quoted in narrative (e.g. net surplus GBP 6.0m) and closed-year/back-year contributions (e.g. GBP 17.6m) but these are net of reinsurance. The statutory notes provide a full claims development triangle (gross) but deriving an aggregate prior-year movement requires diagonal comparisons (triangle method). Due to the presence of funds-withheld RITC arrangements and RITC activity across related syndicates, and the absence of a single gross prior-year movement line, a reliable consolidated GROSS prior year development figure could not be calculated with high confidence from the published tables within the time available; prior_year_development_gbp_m is therefore left null. Some LOB-level back-year releases are discussed in the narrative (e.g. GBP 6.2m gross back-year release partly from a large Irish motor account) and have been included where explicitly stated.
